title: Project Helios
summary: An academic project management case for a 150 MW utility-scale solar photovoltaic development with battery energy storage and grid interconnection. The work integrates scope, schedule, cost, governance, contractor responsibilities, risk, and stakeholder planning across the full project life cycle.

tools: WBS, schedule, risk, and stakeholder planning
highlights: Structured the project from site feasibility and permitting through engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout
Reconciled a task-level cost model to a $500 million planning baseline, including a $26.852 million contingency reserve
Built phase summaries, monthly spend allocations, labor-hour estimates, source notes, and validation checks
Mapped multi-party contractor responsibilities and defined governance, stakeholder priorities, risks, assumptions, constraints, and milestone acceptance criteria
statusNote: Academic planning scenario developed for coursework. Figures represent project assumptions and do not describe an actual Amazon or AWS capital project. Source files remain unpublished while presentation figures and public-use permissions are reviewed.
